# ArmorInnovate

> Professional operating system for sustainability practitioners. Learning, AI-sourced answers, and tools covering GHG accounting, ESG frameworks, carbon markets, and 120+ regulations across 14+ geographies. Built by a team of consultants from top consulting firms with 10+ years of experience across Finance, Environmental Science, Energy Efficiency, and Renewable Energy.

## Core

- [ArmorInnovate homepage](https://armorinnovate.com): Platform overview and entry points.
- [About ArmorInnovate](https://armorinnovate.com/about): Mission, values, and team context.
- [Pricing](https://armorinnovate.com/pricing): Free, Individual, and Pro tiers.
- [Sitemap](https://armorinnovate.com/sitemap.xml): Full indexable URL set.

## Guides (definitive reference pages)

- [CBAM 2026: The Definitive Regime Explained](https://armorinnovate.com/guides/cbam-2026-definitive-regime): EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism definitive regime starting 2026, including certificate surrender, deadlines, pricing, and worked examples.
- [How to Calculate Financed Emissions](https://armorinnovate.com/guides/how-to-calculate-financed-emissions): PCAF methodology walkthrough for Scope 3 Category 15 financed emissions.

## Courses (23 courses, 552+ lessons)

- [All courses](https://armorinnovate.com/courses): Catalogue of structured curricula across climate, carbon, ESG, and sustainable finance.
- [Climate Science 101](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/climate-science-101): Foundational climate science grounded in IPCC AR6.
- [GHG Scope 1 & 2](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/ghg-scope-1-2): Direct emissions and purchased energy, GHG Protocol Corporate Standard.
- [GHG Scope 3](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/ghg-scope-3): Value-chain emissions across 15 categories.
- [EU CBAM](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/eu-cbam): Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism in full.
- [EU SFDR](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/eu-sfdr): Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation and PAI indicators.
- [EU Taxonomy](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/eu-taxonomy): Taxonomy-eligibility and -alignment assessment.
- [EUDR](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/eudr): EU Deforestation Regulation compliance.
- [IFRS S2](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/ifrs-s2): Climate-related disclosures under ISSB.
- [SBTi](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/sbti): Science-based target setting and certification.
- [TNFD Biodiversity](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/tnfd-biodiversity): Nature-related financial disclosures.
- [VCM 101](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/vcm-101): Voluntary carbon market fundamentals.
- [Article 6](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/article-6): Paris Agreement Article 6 carbon markets.
- [Financed Emissions](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/financed-emissions): PCAF-aligned methodology.
- [Double Materiality](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/double-materiality): Financial and impact materiality assessment.
- [ESG Reporting](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/esg-reporting): GRI, SASB, CDP, integrated reporting.
- [ESG Investing](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/esg-investing): Integration, screening, and impact approaches.
- [ESG Benchmarking](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/esg-benchmarking): Rating agencies and scoring methodologies.
- [Carbon Taxation and ETS](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/carbon-taxation-and-ets): ETS, carbon taxes, internal carbon pricing.
- [Circular Economy](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/circular-economy): Design, materials, end-of-life strategy.
- [Human Rights Due Diligence](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/human-rights-dd): OECD and UNGP frameworks.
- [IFC Performance Standards](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/ifc-performance-standards): Eight standards for environmental and social risk.
- [VM0042](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/vm0042): Verra agricultural land management methodology.
- [VM0044](https://armorinnovate.com/courses/vm0044): Verra biochar methodology.

## Tools

- [Emission Factor Database](https://armorinnovate.com/emission-factors): Searchable library of GHG emission factors with full provenance, citations, and vintage tracking. Covers DEFRA, US EPA, India CEA, IPCC and more.
- [Emission Factor search](https://armorinnovate.com/emission-factors/search): Query interface.
- [Emission Factor sources](https://armorinnovate.com/emission-factors/sources): Primary source documents.
- [Carbon Market Intelligence](https://armorinnovate.com/carbon/market): Voluntary carbon market price points and volumes across registries.
- [Carbon Retirement Leaderboard](https://armorinnovate.com/carbon/retirements): Who retired the most credits across Verra, Gold Standard, ACR, CAR, and 11+ registries.
- [Prompt Library](https://armorinnovate.com/prompt-library): Curated prompts for sustainability practitioner workflows.
- [SustainIQ](https://armorinnovate.com/ask): AI Q&A with citations to primary regulatory sources.
